First release of **toolsmoke** — tell you in one command whether your LLM endpoint actually works for agents (tool calling, streaming, structured output) and how fast it is.

### Install

```bash
uvx --from git+https://github.com/Blackman99/toolsmoke@v0.1.0 toolsmoke --demo broken
# or
pipx install https://github.com/Blackman99/toolsmoke/releases/download/v0.1.0/toolsmoke-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl
```

### Highlights

- **31 probes**: chat basics, streaming + usage, single / parallel / streamed tool calls, `tool_choice` none / required / named, tool-markup leaks into content, multi-turn tool results, JSON mode, JSON schema, reasoning separation (`<think>` leaks), error semantics, Anthropic Messages API (opt-in `--anthropic`), TTFT p50 and tokens/sec
- **Pass / warn / fail table**, `--format json|markdown`, `--json FILE`, exit code 0 / 1 / 2, `--strict`, `--max-ttft`, `--min-tps`
- **GitHub Action**: `uses: Blackman99/toolsmoke@v0.1.0` writes a job summary and exposes verdict/counts/TTFT/tps outputs
- **Mock server** with 11 injectable real-world defects, and `toolsmoke --demo good|broken` to see it without a model
- Zero runtime dependencies, Python 3.9+

Docs: https://blackman99.github.io/toolsmoke/docs/
